title: Composition and Expertise of Steering Committee for Singapore College of Islamic Studies
what_it_is: Composition and Expertise of Steering Committee for Singapore College of Islamic Studies

sections.label: Non-Muslim Board and Steering members
sections.summary: Non-Muslim members are less than half of the Board of Governors and Steering Committee, appointed for expertise in working with the Muslim community.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: The non-Muslim members make up less than half of the Board of Governors and Steering Committee, and are appointed for their diverse expertise and experience in working with the Muslim community.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: They include professionals and experts in areas such as leading Institutions of Higher Learning (IHLs), the social sciences and professional development, which contribute to SCIS' interdisciplinary approach.

sections.label: Board members induction programme
sections.summary: All Board members undergo a structured induction programme covering the College's mission, vision, values and objectives.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: All Board members undergo a structured induction programme, which includes briefings on the mission, vision and values, and objectives of the College.

sections.label: Professional development and career support unit
sections.summary: A dedicated professional development and career support unit is planned for students, with an ecosystem to equip asatizah with competencies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Fadli Fawzi (Aljunied)
sentences.text: And third, will this college have a dedicated professional development and career support unit for the students?

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We are planning perhaps for more than 50 students and we will expand this further.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: In terms of careers, as I mentioned, it will be much broader compared to what we can see today.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Not just broad, we want to develop an ecosystem that equips our asatizah with competencies, where even though they can work in social organisations or jobs related to social work, we want them to obtain the highest competencies.

sections.label: Advisory Panel members' feedback
sections.summary: Advisory Panel members said this is something they have been looking for, but no country has done it.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: When I engage the members of the Advisory Panel, they shared with me that this is something that they have been looking for, but no country has done it and in fact, their countries have different context from ours.

sections.label: MABIMS colleagues' shared sentiment
sections.summary: MABIMS colleagues shared the same sentiment, calling it unique and something Singapore is in a better place to do.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: I also met my colleagues from MABIMS during my recent meeting.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: They shared the same sentiment – something unique, something that Singapore is in a better place to do, and that is something we want to shape together.

sections.label: Milestone for Muslim community
sections.summary: Today is a milestone to bring the Muslim community forward and be part of nation building in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: For today, is a milestone for us to bring the Muslim community forward and to be part of nation building here in Singapore.
